summary: v2-10 replicated run-level, and the mandated feasibility check passed first: a single-node YB arm runs here, so the 2 GiB blocker is a multi-node limit. On yb-single the correct designs refused valid holds (s1 2 then 3, s2 1 in each) with EVERY refusal classified transient, and the retry variant s1r refused nothing with all 5 retries succeeding; on pg-single all three correct designs refused nothing at five tiers in both runs while the declared negative control s0 refused and stole holds on both engines (so PG is a real control, not a quieter instrument). Two of my predictions (N3, N4) are falsified and recorded. Merged to main 8aa5d6b, tagged study-03-t1-replication-v1 and study-03/v2-10-refusal-replication.
